en-US.author: Stencil Labs, Inc.
en-US.description: Isolated, copy-on-write checkouts of any folder for agents, served by one daemon as a single mount.
en-US.longDescription:
Checkouts for agents: isolated, copy-on-write views of any folder, a git repository or not, opened without copying it. Agents work in the checkout; you review with diff and merge back with a three-way apply. Checkouts can be snapshotted, forked, and attached to another machine, where their content arrives on first read.

One daemon serves every checkout as a folder of a single mount: NFSv3 on macOS, FUSE on Linux, SMB or WinFsp on Windows. No root, and no kernel extension beyond WinFsp where you install it.

Opening a folder sorts every path into a class. source paths are captured: they are what diff, apply and snapshots see, and the only bytes that leave the machine. cache and local paths (build outputs, ignored files, secrets) show the live folder until the checkout writes them. hidden paths are absent. Writes go to the checkout's own copy-on-write layer, so the folder is never written until you apply. In a git repository the checkout gets a private git directory: commit freely, then apply --branch NAME to bring the commits back.

ovnfs reads and writes git repositories itself, so it needs no git installation; fetches use git when it is on the PATH. Verbs start the daemon when none is running, and start, stop, restart and status manage it. restart swaps in the daemon of the binary you run, e.g. after an upgrade, leaving an NFS or SMB mount and the shells inside it in place.

- new opens a checkout on a folder, git revision or snapshot; run uses a disposable checkout that is removed afterwards.
- snap freezes a checkout's changes into a snapshot; fork opens a second checkout on one.
- diff lists source changes since a snapshot, optionally as a git patch; apply merges them back with a three-way merge.
- grep and glob search the daemon without traversing the mount.
- ls, prune and rm manage checkouts and their snapshots.
- attach, send, pull and push move a checkout to another machine over ssh, fetching content lazily on first read.
- explain reports which class a path gets and which rule decided; completion provides bash, zsh and fish completion.

ovnfs isolates files, not processes: it is not a sandbox.

zh-CN.description: 为智能体提供任意文件夹的隔离写时复制检出，由单个守护进程作为一个挂载点提供服务。
zh-CN.longDescription:
面向智能体的检出：任意文件夹（无论是否为 git 仓库）的隔离写时复制视图，无需复制即可打开。智能体在检出中工作，您通过 diff 审阅改动，并用三方 apply 合并回去。检出可以创建快照、派生，并附加到另一台机器，其内容在首次读取时到达。

一个守护进程将每个检出作为单个挂载点中的一个文件夹提供服务：macOS 上使用 NFSv3，Linux 上使用 FUSE，Windows 上使用 SMB 或 WinFsp。无需 root，除您自行安装的 WinFsp 外不需要内核扩展。

打开文件夹时，每个路径都会被归入一个类别。source 路径会被捕获：它们是 diff、apply 和快照所看到的内容，也是唯一会离开本机的字节。cache 和 local 路径（构建产物、被忽略的文件、机密）在检出写入之前显示实时文件夹的内容。hidden 路径则不存在。写入会进入检出自己的写时复制层，因此在您 apply 之前绝不会写入原文件夹。在 git 仓库中，检出会获得一个私有 git 目录：您可以自由提交，然后用 apply --branch NAME 将提交带回来。

ovnfs 自行读写 git 仓库，因此不需要安装 git；当 PATH 中存在 git 时，抓取操作会使用它。没有守护进程运行时，各个动词会自动启动它，start、stop、restart 和 status 用于管理守护进程。restart 会切换到您所运行二进制文件的守护进程（例如升级之后），同时保留 NFS 或 SMB 挂载以及其中的 shell。

- new 在文件夹、git 修订版或快照上打开检出；run 使用一次性检出，运行结束后将其移除。
- snap 将检出的改动冻结为快照；fork 在快照上打开第二个检出。
- diff 列出相对某个快照的源改动，可选择输出为 git 补丁；apply 通过三方合并将其合并回去。
- grep 和 glob 在守护进程中搜索，无需遍历挂载点。
- ls、prune 和 rm 管理检出及其快照。
- attach、send、pull 和 push 通过 ssh 将检出移动到另一台机器，并在首次读取时惰性获取内容。
- explain 报告某个路径归入哪个类别以及由哪条规则决定；completion 提供 bash、zsh 和 fish 补全。

ovnfs 隔离的是文件，而不是进程：它不是沙盒。
